paper_id: CodeBERT_ A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages__oa_W3098605233
title: CodeBERT: A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages
motivation: Pre-trained models revolutionized NLP but lacked bimodal NL-PL representations for code understanding and generation tasks
problem_framing: Treat NL and PL as separate modalities, learn cross-modal representations using both bimodal (paired) and unimodal (unpaired) code data
key_insight: Hybrid objective combining MLM on bimodal data with replaced token detection on unimodal data enables leveraging abundant unpaired code
method_signature: RoBERTa-base Transformer + MLM + RTD objectives trained on 6 PL languages
evaluation_criteria: MRR for code search; BLEU for code generation; zero-shot accuracy for NL-PL probing
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Incorporating AST into pre-training does not bring improvements; code2seq with AST paths still outperforms
evidence_for_taste: the fuels for model training include not only bimodal data
we implement two efficient n-gram language models
